policy: Do not invent coordinates from addresses or names.
Do not treat business listing metadata as a photo reference.
Resolve conflicting addresses and same-number listings before adding a business to the route.
Only mark a facade visually verified after matching a current image to a precise location.
Do not redistribute third-party photographs or logos without permission.
The named grocery and coffee shop in the 2024 report are historical/contextual leads, not exact geolocated facade records.
